title: Video On Demand
html:
Our TV service provider make/c video content marketing GmbH offers free material for all TV channels and online TV formats.

We are also happy to try to fulfil your requests for interviews, filming requests or to establish contacts. In addition, you can book ENG crews and an editing suite on site for your own reporting.


Free moving-image material

Editorial and free moving-image material in SD and HD is available from our TV service make/c video content marketing GmbH GmbH. A cut short version without sound, a German version with sound and an English version with sound, lasting approx. 2-3 mins are provided, as well as supplementary rough cut material lasting approx. 10 mins (interviews, trends, new products, events and general trade fair pictures etc. incl. script and shot list).
